annotation.title_clean: Komisia uverejňuje usmernenia k vymedzeniu systému umelej inteligencie s cieľom uľahčiť uplatňovanie pravidiel prvého aktu o umelej inteligencii
annotation.title_en: Commission publishes guidelines on the AI system definition to facilitate the first AI Act rules' application
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page announcing its non-binding guidelines on the definition of an AI system under the EU AI Act, published 6 February 2025 alongside guidelines on prohibited practices. It notes the first AI Act rules, including the definition, AI literacy and prohibitions, applied from 2 February 2025, and lists translations.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines explain practical application of the AI system definition in the AI Act.
The guidelines are non-binding and will be updated over time.
Published alongside guidelines on prohibited AI practices.
First AI Act rules, including the definition, AI literacy and prohibitions, applied from 2 February 2025.
The AI Act classifies systems into prohibited, high-risk and transparency-obligation categories.
